# tag: school.math.binary
what is 0 in binary | 0 in binary | convert 0 to binary | how do you write 0 in binary => In binary, 0 is written 0, the same as in our usual base 10.
what is 1 in binary | 1 in binary | convert 1 to binary | how do you write 1 in binary => In binary, 1 is written 1, the same as in our usual base 10.
what is 2 in binary | 2 in binary | convert 2 to binary | how do you write 2 in binary => In binary, 2 is written 10. It's a power of 2, so it's a 1 followed by 1 zero.
what is 3 in binary | 3 in binary | convert 3 to binary | how do you write 3 in binary => In binary, 3 is written 11, one less than 4. A number made of all 1s in binary is always one less than a power of 2.

# tag: school.math.hexadecimal
what is 10 in hexadecimal | 10 in hex | convert 10 to hex | how do you write 10 in hex => In hexadecimal (base 16), 10 is written A. Hex uses 0 to 9, then A to F for 10 to 15.
what is 11 in hexadecimal | 11 in hex | convert 11 to hex | how do you write 11 in hex => In hexadecimal (base 16), 11 is written B. Hex uses 0 to 9, then A to F for 10 to 15.
what is 12 in hexadecimal | 12 in hex | convert 12 to hex | how do you write 12 in hex => In hexadecimal (base 16), 12 is written C. Hex uses 0 to 9, then A to F for 10 to 15.
what is 13 in hexadecimal | 13 in hex | convert 13 to hex | how do you write 13 in hex => In hexadecimal (base 16), 13 is written D. Hex uses 0 to 9, then A to F for 10 to 15.
what is 14 in hexadecimal | 14 in hex | convert 14 to hex | how do you write 14 in hex => In hexadecimal (base 16), 14 is written E. Hex uses 0 to 9, then A to F for 10 to 15.
what is 15 in hexadecimal | 15 in hex | convert 15 to hex | how do you write 15 in hex => In hexadecimal (base 16), 15 is written F. Hex uses 0 to 9, then A to F for 10 to 15.
what is 16 in hexadecimal | 16 in hex | convert 16 to hex | how do you write 16 in hex => In hexadecimal (base 16), 16 is written 10, because 1 × 16 + 0 = 16. Hex uses 0 to 9 and A to F for 10 to 15.
what is 20 in hexadecimal | 20 in hex | convert 20 to hex | how do you write 20 in hex => In hexadecimal (base 16), 20 is written 14, because 1 × 16 + 4 = 20. Hex uses 0 to 9 and A to F for 10 to 15.
what is 32 in hexadecimal | 32 in hex | convert 32 to hex | how do you write 32 in hex => In hexadecimal (base 16), 32 is written 20, because 2 × 16 + 0 = 32. Hex uses 0 to 9 and A to F for 10 to 15.
what is 100 in hexadecimal | 100 in hex | convert 100 to hex | how do you write 100 in hex => In hexadecimal (base 16), 100 is written 64, because 6 × 16 + 4 = 100. Hex uses 0 to 9 and A to F for 10 to 15.
what is 255 in hexadecimal | 255 in hex | convert 255 to hex | how do you write 255 in hex => In hexadecimal (base 16), 255 is written FF, because 15 × 16 + 15 = 255. Hex uses 0 to 9 and A to F for 10 to 15.
what is 256 in hexadecimal | 256 in hex | convert 256 to hex | how do you write 256 in hex => In hexadecimal (base 16), 256 is written 100. Hex place values are 1, 16 and 256, so 100 means one 256.
